motivation: M6.3-15 post-hoc physical-rule audit showed A and B hide internal differences behind saturated valence-2 middle atoms and share reactive S0/S1 ends. Compare new C(S0/S0 ends) and D(S1/S1 ends) while retaining A/B same-terminal negative control and reversed orientation controls, with existing M6 chemistry untouched.
epistemic_status: Prerecorded new-seed synthetic-probe mechanistic validation of local terminal chemistry, NOT spontaneous life, templated information transmission or heritable reproduction.
single_campaign: Ten steps M6.3-17..26 are ten evaluations of one new 144-universe dataset, NOT ten independent samples.

world.identical_chemistry: source M6 S1-S2 allowed, S0-S2 forbidden; original same S0/S1 equal max_bonds 2, S2 max_bonds 1, S3 0; catalysts unchanged/off
world.matched_initial: Same per-density/seed non-source background positions/species and state RNG after placement in all six arms; all templates have two S0 and two S1, three bonds, identical total initial energy and ledger. Species per source site differ deliberately, thus site-specific energies and rates may differ.

ten_gates.name: Freeze protocol, verify 4 distinct canonical signatures and identical initial background/energy
Audit initial static pair generator: A=B and A_reverse=B_reverse; S0-terminal C has no S2 partner, D can have eligible S2 if adjacent
Record actual local S2 proximity and eligible source-terminal/S2 pairs before the first original-edge break
Record accepted BondEvent source-terminal/S2 formation strictly before any original-edge break, distinguishing actual chemistry from exposure
Track uninterrupted three-edge core survival and first break, with censoring
Compare A/B internal controls and A/B spatial reversal without presuming synchronized RNG after divergence
Trace purity loss, core growth, source saturation and external monomer/cluster attaches
Count disjoint new exact A/B/C/D motifs near/far and stratified by pure/grown/broken; no proximity-based lineage claims
Full suite, invariant checks on all runs and independent identical-hash replay on two preselected seed/density/arm pairs
Consolidate descriptive terminal-chemistry findings, assess preregistered gate, publish ten reports and next decision

metrics.primary: Sum of accepted source-terminal(IDs 0 or 3) to S2-atom bonds in the continuous-unbroken-core window; count only if ALL original edges have never broken before or during that transition. Report by density/arm/seed; source C should be structural negative control.
metrics.opportunities: On t=0 and after each step while original core still continuously unbroken, count statically eligible terminal-to-S2 von Neumann adjacent pairs using true _candidate_pairs (without RNG), no guessing contact rates. Also report adjacent but ineligible S2.
metrics.safety: Observer records BondEvent in pre-step t and maps it to post-step t+1; never changes ledger, reactions, RNG, particles or configuration.
metrics.core: Track exact pure quartet, three original bonds physically present, never-broken window, first break, first growth, formed external S0/S1/S2 source bonds and terminal-specific S2.
metrics.motifs: For each exact four-atom signature A/B/C/D, count first new material atom-set (signature, sorted IDs) without any prior connected component containing source ID, within Manhattan toroidal radius <=2 around original four scaffold sites. Separate pure, grown_with_original_edges and original_edges_missing phases.
metrics.control: A and B share endpoints; C both S0 termini (S2 forbidden) and D both S1 termini (S2 allowed); all isoenergetic as total system, not necessarily per-particle energy. A/B reverse test spatial anisotropy. Local S2 reaction differences are predicted trivially by allowed_pairs, NOT inheritance.
metrics.null_output: Every zero, right-censored bond, per-run data, hash and RNG fingerprint must be reported.

decision.terminal_chemistry_gate: At BOTH densities, D must have strictly more actual accepted S2 source-terminal bonds than C in the still-unbroken window, AND D must exhibit at least one accepted bond per density. Only then label 'verified_local_terminal_chemistry' (a mechanistic positive control, not replication).
decision.negative_A_B_gate: At t0, exact _candidate_pairs must match A and B, likewise A_reverse and B_reverse, when seeded backgrounds are paired; do not demand subsequent trajectories match.
decision.specificity_gate: Report motif count distribution, but NEVER infer heritable structure from new-near matches; only flag any unexpected difference for a new independent causal test. No generation count in this dataset.
decision.outcome_if_no_positive: If zero accepted D-S2 in a density, declare opportunity-limited/inconclusive; DO NOT alter seed/density/duration after inspection.
decision.next_step: Only if terminal chemistry is verified consider future protocol that tests transmission of a variant under coupled geometry-matched reaction opportunity, separate from trivial terminal chemistry. Any law modification requires independent approval.

integrity.replay_compare: Final full hash, RNG fingerprint and draws, energy+dissipation, formed/broken bonds, exact per-run observer metrics
